text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Uuugh, fell just one step short...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Still, next time for sure, I'll definitely 
take 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Still, next time for sure, I'll definitely 
take 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Still, what I want to show everyone is 
something even higher— the very peak of 
racing!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Even if I get good results, I shouldn't 
get cocky, I've gotta keep working even 
harder.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer, please guide and train me well!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, alright, once we get back, I'm 
gonna run a whole bunch!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Kitasan Black's positive attitude 
made a warm feeling swell in my chest.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Our seniors at the academy told us too, 
that "the racing world is unforgiving," 
and "if you let your guard down, you'll be 
overtaken in an instant."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
We can't get cocky— we need to train hard 
and aim for the championship!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer, please continue to guide me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking into Kitasan Black's eyes as she 
gazed at the future, I could sense her 
growing resilience.
